name: Incus
description: Virtual machines and containers on an Incus server for rookery hosts.

hostFeatures.label: Incus server
hostFeatures.description: Install Incus on a node and set it up for rookery's machines: the bridge incusbr0 for the guests, a storage pool in a directory, and the API on port 8444 for clients it trusts by certificate. rookery's own client certificate is trusted, and rookery registers the provisioners incus/vm and incus/container of this node after the apply. An Incus that is set up already keeps its pools, networks and trust. The settings are rookery_incus_* in the profile's ansible_vars; the guide has them.
hostFeatures.summary: Incus (`incus`) hosts virtual machines and containers here, on the bridge `incusbr0`.

actions.name: server-status
actions.label: Incus
actions.help: The version of Incus, its storage pools and its instances. Part of Status.
actions.run: echo; echo '── Incus'; incus version; incus storage list --format compact; incus list --format compact --columns nst

provisioners.label: Incus virtual machine
provisioners.description: A KVM guest on an Incus server, set up from rookery's cloud seed. The server needs KVM.

arguments.label: Incus server
arguments.help: The address of the Incus server's API, such as https://192.0.2.10:8443.

arguments.name: project
arguments.label: Project
arguments.help: The Incus project rookery makes its machines in and looks at.

kinds.label: Machine
kinds.description: A KVM guest on an Incus server, set up from rookery's cloud seed.

arguments.label: CPUs

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory it gets, such as 8GiB.

arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image on images.linuxcontainers.org to start from. It has to have cloud-init.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Storage pool

arguments.name: network
arguments.label: Network
arguments.help: The network it is attached to. Empty takes the network of the default profile.

images.help: A cloud image, which runs the seed.

images.help: A cloud image, which runs the seed.

kinds.label: Virtual machine from an image
kinds.description: A virtual machine from an image on images.linuxcontainers.org, which puts nothing of rookery in it.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image on images.linuxcontainers.org to start from, such as debian/12 or alpine/3.20. It becomes no rookery host: nothing of rookery is put in it.

arguments.name: user_data
arguments.label: Cloud-init user data
arguments.help: What cloud-init does on its first boot, such as packages to install and users to add, for an image that has cloud-init. Empty leaves the image as it is.

arguments.name: cpus
arguments.label: CPUs
arguments.help: How many CPUs the virtual machine gets.

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory it gets, such as 2GiB.

arguments.name: disk
arguments.label: Disk size
arguments.help: The size of its root disk, such as 20GiB.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Storage pool
arguments.help: The storage pool of the Incus server its disk is in.

arguments.name: network
arguments.label: Network
arguments.help: The network it is attached to. Empty takes the network of the default profile.

collections.label: Storage pool
collections.help: The storage pools of the server, which hold the disks of machines, the cached images and the custom volumes.

collections.label: Volume
collections.help: The custom volumes of the storage pools in the project, which an instance can mount.

collections.label: Cached image
collections.help: The images the server keeps in its project. Incus fetches one from images.linuxcontainers.org when a machine first needs it, and again after it is removed.

collections.label: Instance
collections.help: The machines and instances rookery made with the provisioner, whose actions are on the page of each.

actions.name: server
actions.label: Check the server
actions.help: Ask the Incus server for its version, its kernel and its storage drivers, and whether it trusts rookery's client certificate.

actions.name: pools
actions.label: Storage pools
actions.help: The storage pools of the server as a table: each one's driver, source, size, used and free space, and whether it can grow, or why not.

actions.name: images
actions.label: Cached images
actions.help: The images the server keeps in its project, with their sizes. Incus fetches one from images.linuxcontainers.org when a machine first needs it.

actions.name: networks
actions.label: Networks
actions.help: The networks of the server a machine can be attached to.

actions.name: volumes
actions.label: Volumes
actions.help: The custom volumes of every storage pool in the project, with their sizes and whether an instance uses each.

actions.name: create-volume
actions.label: New volume
actions.help: Create a custom volume in a storage pool, which an instance can mount.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Pool
arguments.help: The storage pool to create it in.

arguments.name: name
arguments.label: Name
arguments.help: The name of the volume, such as wiki-data.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: Size
arguments.help: The largest the volume may grow, such as 10GiB. Empty leaves it to the pool.

actions.name: remove-volume
actions.label: Remove volume
actions.confirm: Remove this volume and everything in it?
actions.help: Remove a custom volume and what is in it. Incus refuses it while an instance uses it.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Pool
arguments.help: The storage pool it is in.

arguments.name: name
arguments.label: Name
arguments.help: The name of the volume to remove.

actions.name: create-pool
actions.label: New storage pool
actions.help: Create a storage pool on the server, for machines, instances and volumes.

arguments.name: name
arguments.label: Name
arguments.help: The name of the pool, such as fast.

arguments.name: driver
arguments.label: Driver
arguments.help: How the pool keeps its data. dir uses a folder on the server; the others make a loop file of the given size unless the server is set up otherwise.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: Size
arguments.help: The size of the loop file for zfs, btrfs and lvm, such as 50GiB. dir takes no size.

actions.name: remove-pool
actions.label: Remove storage pool
actions.help: Remove a storage pool. Incus refuses it while it holds instances, volumes or images.

arguments.name: name
arguments.label: Name
arguments.help: The name of the pool to remove.

actions.name: remove-image
actions.label: Remove image
actions.confirm: Remove this image from the server?
actions.help: Remove a cached image from the project. Incus fetches it again when something needs it.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image's alias, or the start of its fingerprint as the cached images show it.

actions.name: resize-pool
actions.label: Grow storage pool
actions.confirm: Grow this storage pool? Incus cannot shrink it again.
actions.help: Grow a loop-backed btrfs, zfs or lvm pool to a new size. A dir pool has no size of its own, and a pool on a device or dataset that was given when it was made is grown there instead.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Pool
arguments.help: The storage pool to grow.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: Size
arguments.help: Its new size, larger than it is now, such as 100GiB or 200GB.

actions.name: set-pool
actions.label: Change storage pool
actions.help: Change a setting of a storage pool that Incus allows to change once it is made: description, volume.size, volume.snapshots.schedule and volume.snapshots.expiry, rsync.bwlimit and rsync.compression of a dir pool, btrfs.mount_options of a btrfs pool, and zfs.clone_copy and zfs.export of a zfs pool.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Pool
arguments.help: The storage pool to change.

arguments.name: key
arguments.label: Setting
arguments.help: The setting, such as volume.size or description.

arguments.name: value
arguments.label: Value
arguments.help: Its new value, such as 20GiB for volume.size. Empty unsets it.

actions.name: resize-volume
actions.label: Resize volume
actions.help: Give a custom volume a new size. Incus grows any volume, and shrinks a filesystem volume only to no less than it holds; a block volume cannot shrink.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Pool
arguments.help: The storage pool it is in.

arguments.name: volume
arguments.label: Volume
arguments.help: The name of the volume.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: Size
arguments.help: Its new size, such as 20GiB.

actions.name: resize-disk
actions.label: Grow root disk
actions.help: Grow the root disk of an instance. One that has its root disk from a profile gets one of its own. A container has the new size at once; a virtual machine's guest sees it after a restart, which happens only with restart=yes.

arguments.name: instance
arguments.label: Instance
arguments.help: The instance's name as the server lists it, such as rookery-studio for the host studio.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: Size
arguments.help: The new size of its root disk, larger than it is now, such as 80GiB.

arguments.name: restart
arguments.label: Restart
arguments.help: Whether to restart a running virtual machine so that its guest sees the new size. A container needs no restart.
